parameters.query: SELECT id, content, role, metadata FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE session_id = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.id }}' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC;

INSERT INTO ai_rag (id, content, embedding, response, usage_count, success_rate, examples, negative_examples, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2::vector, $3, 1, $4, $5, $6, NOW()) RETURNING id;
UPDATE ai_rag SET usage_count = $1, success_rate = $2, examples = $3, negative_examples = $4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $5;
SELECT id, usage_count, success_rate, examples, negative_examples, (embedding <-> $1::vector) AS distance FROM ai_rag ORDER BY embedding <-> $1::vector ASC LIMIT 1;
